profile.name: Mingyu Bian
profile.affiliation: Undergraduate in Intelligence Science and Technology, Xinjiang University
profile.affiliation_zh: 新疆大学未来技术学院智能科学与技术专业本科生
profile.research_interests: AI for Science. Genomic regulation, molecular conformation, multimodal RNA language models, structured machine learning, interpretable inference, and decision-making under uncertainty.
profile.research_interests_zh: 科学智能（AI for Science）。基因组调控与分子构象建模，包括多模态 RNA 语言模型。结构化机器学习与可解释推断。不确定性下的预测与决策。

items.title: Xinjiang University
items.title_zh: 新疆大学
details: Undergraduate in Intelligence Science and Technology, School of Future Technology.

Coursework includes Advanced Mathematics, Linear Algebra, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, Data Structures and Algorithms, Advanced Programming (Python), Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Software Engineering, Microcontrollers and Interface Technology, and Image Signal Processing.
English: CET-4 453; English Test for International Communication (ETIC), CLA-Basic Pass.
details_zh: 未来技术学院智能科学与技术专业本科
主要课程包括高等数学、线性代数、概率论与数理统计、数据结构与算法、高级程序设计（Python）、机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理、软件工程、单片机与接口技术和图像信号处理等。
英语能力：CET-4 453 分，国际人才英语考试（ETIC）CLA-Basic 通过。

items.title: Tsinghua Qian Xuesen Program & Shenzhen X-Institute
items.title_zh: 清华大学钱学森班与深圳零一学院
details: Zero One Scholar in the joint training program. The research training curriculum comprises ESRT, ORIC, and SURF.
details_zh: 联合培养零一学者。科研训练包括 ESRT、ORIC 和 SURF。

items.title: AI for Drug Discovery Symposium: From Target to Deal
items.title_zh: AI+新药研发研讨会：从靶点到交易

items.title: Fudan University · Summer School in Mathematical Logic
items.title_zh: 复旦大学 · 数理逻辑暑期学校
details: Foundations and applications of recursion theory with Liang Yu, including computable forcing, higher recursion theory, and algorithmic information theory.
details_zh: 学习喻良老师的《递归论基础及其应用》，内容包括能行力迫法、高阶递归论和算法信息论。

items.title: Institute of High Energy Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
items.title_zh: 中国科学院高能物理研究所
details: Individual undergraduate research project supervised by Haiyun Teng. Built a GPU streaming prototype and software framework for data acquisition, experiment-specific image analysis, output debugging, and monitoring on neutron spectrometers. The framework uses direct memory access and concurrent GPU image processing.
details_zh: 滕海云副研究员指导的本科生独立项目。构建面向中子谱仪的 GPU 流式数据采集原型与软件框架，支持直接内存访问读出、并发图像处理、实验专用图像分析、输出调试和监控。

items.title: Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences
items.title_zh: 中国科学院软件研究所
details: Individual undergraduate project supervised by Junjie Wang. Built MemoDroid, a lightweight plug-in with three-tier memory for LLM-based GUI testing, and evaluated it on at least 200 real applications across 15 categories.
details_zh: 王俊杰研究员指导的本科生独立项目。开发 MemoDroid，为大语言模型驱动的 GUI 测试提供三层记忆轻量插件，并在覆盖 15 类的至少 200 个真实应用中评估。

items.title: Shenzhen Bay Laboratory
items.title_zh: 深圳湾实验室
details: Visiting student in Prof. Yaoqi Zhou’s group, Institute of Systems and Physical Biology. Applied contrastive learning to RESM for downstream tasks and worked on extending it to multimodal inputs.
details_zh: 系统与物理生物学研究所周耀旗课题组访问学生。将对比学习应用于 RESM 的下游任务，并研究其多模态输入扩展。

items.title: Plant counting and replanting decisions from drone imagery
items.title_zh: 无人机影像作物计数与补种决策
details: Team lead, Undergraduate Innovation Training Program. Proposed a lightweight detector, aerial imaging, and GIS workflow to count plants and map missing seedlings for replanting.
details_zh: 大学生创新训练计划团队第一负责人。提出结合轻量目标检测、无人机影像和 GIS 的方案，统计植株数量并绘制缺苗位置，以辅助补种。

items.title: Open-source processor design · X-Fusion
items.title_zh: 开源处理器设计 · X-Fusion
details: Primary team lead. Recreated RISC-I and Cray-I architecture designs using open-source EDA tools and built a RISC-V vector arithmetic prototype. Received the X-Fusion Jingrui Award.
details_zh: 团队第一负责人。使用开源 EDA 工具复现 RISC-I 和 Cray-I 架构设计，实现 RISC-V 矢量算术原型，获 X-Fusion 零一菁锐奖。

items.title: 2nd Change Maker Youth Initiative for Agricultural Heritage
items.title_zh: 第二届 Change Maker 农业文化遗产青年创变者行动
details: Team captain and project lead. Led fieldwork on wheat farming and processing in Shuanghe, Xinjiang.
details_zh: 队长兼第一负责人。带队在新疆双河市调研小麦种植与加工。

items.title: 3rd Movers4Climate Youth Green Action Initiative
items.title_zh: 第三届 Movers4Climate 绿色乡村青年行动
details: Team captain and project lead. Led five climate and sustainability lessons that reached 151 students.
details_zh: 队长兼第一负责人。带队开展五节气候行动与可持续发展课程，惠及 151 名学生。

details: Team captain and project lead. Led a 14-day teaching program. One group reached 32 students.
details_zh: 队长兼第一负责人。带队开展 14 天公益支教，其中一组课程覆盖 32 名学生。

details: Volunteer in a rural digital-skills education initiative. The team reached over 120 students.
details_zh: 参与乡村数字教育志愿项目，团队惠及 120 余名学生。

items.title_zh: Movers4Climate 绿色乡村青年行动
details: National UN Community Volunteer, team captain and project lead. Led climate literacy and sustainability classes that reached over 180 rural students.
